title: Validation failures return 422, while R9's how_to_verify mentions 400
evidence: lib/book_api/router.ex:97-98 maps map-shaped errors to 422; README.md documents 422 for validation. R8 only requires 'appropriate HTTP status codes', and 422 Unprocessable Entity is RFC-appropriate for validation failures.
suggestion: No change required — 422 is a defensible, documented choice. Noted only for cross-run status-code comparison.
